name: caller-principal-accept-pre-bash-with-a-principal
description: R14 -- the accept-class /hooks/pre-bash in the PRINCIPAL-PRESENT state, on both backends. The principal-absent state of the same request is pinned by strict_mode/06-pre-bash-strict-tracked-stale-denies (its principal-free main request). Python checks the principal it minted and admits; Node issues none, so the harness omits the header there (the claim preflight is Python-scoped), exactly as a conforming client does after a 404 on the claim. Both answer the same.
